description: Export crawl results to a CSV file. STEPS: 1) Enter 'https://crawler-test.com/' in the URL bar and press Enter to start crawling. 2) Wait for crawl to complete (status bar shows 'Crawl Complete' or URL count stops). 3) Click menu 'Bulk Export' at the top. 4) Select 'All' submenu, then choose 'Internal - All' or 'Internal - HTML'. 5) In the save dialog, navigate to /home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/ and save the CSV file. SUCCESS CRITERIA: The exported CSV file must contain at least 5 rows of data with URLs from crawler-test.com.
